info.title: Hatohui API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Hatohui workspace API

code.description: Google OAuth 2.0 authorization code (auth-code popup flow)

name.description: The account's display name — its own chosen name if set, otherwise the name from Google login.

isAdmin.description: Whether this account holds the admin role. Cosmetic only — admin routes enforce their own check and also require the admin key.

isArtist.description: Whether this account holds the artist role — can own commissions, openings and projects.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name this account is scheduled against

birthdayReminderLeadDays.description: Days before a connection's birthday this account is emailed, where 0 is the day itself. Falls back to the app-wide default until the account sets its own; an empty array means birthday emails are off.

birthdayRemindersEnabled.description: Whether birthday reminder emails are sent at all. When false the lead-time settings are kept but nothing is queued.

birthdayReminderDaysBefore.description: Days before a birthday for the daily reminder, where 0 is the day itself. Derived from birthdayReminderLeadDays.

birthdayReminderWeeksBefore.description: Weeks before a birthday for the weekly reminder; 0 means no weekly reminder. Derived from birthdayReminderLeadDays.

handle.description: The associated account's global @handle, if this entry is linked to one

avatarUrl.description: Public URL of the friend's avatar image

isViewerEntry.description: Whether this entry is the requesting viewer's own entry

turningAge.description: Age the friend is turning on their next birthday, null if birthYear is unknown

nextBirthdayDate.description: The friend's next occurring birthday date (year is the anchor year, not necessarily their birth year)

key.description: The section's grouping key: YYYY-MM for 'month', the age/year as a string for 'age'/'year', 'unknown' when the underlying field is unset, or 'all' for group 'none'

hasMore.description: Whether another page can be requested

birthYear.description: Birth year. Null when no birthday is recorded, or the viewer is not allowed to see it.

birthMonth.description: Birth month (1-12), null when the birthday is not visible

birthDay.description: Birth day (1-31), null when the birthday is not visible

visibility.description: Who can see the birthday. Null when there is no birthday to govern. The profile itself is always public.

avatarUrl.description: Public URL of the friend's avatar image

addedById.description: Id of the account that added this entry, if any

handle.description: The profile's global @handle, if it has one

isAssociated.description: Whether this entry is already claimed by an account

isViewerEntry.description: Whether this entry is the requesting viewer's own entry

connectionStatus.description: How the viewer stands with the account behind this entry. Always NONE for entries nobody has claimed — there's no account to connect with.

canEdit.description: Whether the requesting viewer is allowed to edit/delete this entry

id.description: Connection row id, used to accept or withdraw

user.description: The account on the other side, from the viewer’s perspective

incoming.description: Requests waiting on the viewer to accept or decline

outgoing.description: Requests the viewer sent that are still unanswered

userId.description: Account to send a connection request to

actor.description: Who caused this, if anyone (system notifications have none)

subjectId.description: Id of the thing this is about; which table to read it from is implied by `type`

isActionable.description: Whether the viewer can still act on this (e.g. a connection request that is still pending). False once it becomes history.

unreadCount.description: Unread count across all pages, for the bell

friendsOfFriend.description: The next branch out in the social tree view

friends.description: The viewer's connections, for the social tree view

visibility.description: Who can see the birthday. Ignored if no date is given.

avatarKey.description: Object key returned by POST /images/sign, after uploading the avatar file to storage

visibility.description: Who can see the birthday. Ignored if no date is given.

avatarKey.description: Object key returned by POST /images/sign, after uploading the avatar file to storage

url.description: Public URL of this past avatar

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL the client uploads the file bytes to

key.description: Object key the file was signed for

publicUrl.description: Public URL the image is reachable at once uploaded

baseUrl.description: Base URL a handle is appended to

join.description: Whether the user wants to join the list

avatarKey.description: Object key returned by POST /images/sign, after uploading the avatar file to storage

visibility.description: Who can see this birthday. Sent here rather than applied by the visibility step, which runs before the birthday exists.

userIds.description: Accounts to send connection requests to. Connections are between accounts, so these are user ids — unclaimed directory entries have nobody to ask.

handle.description: Global unique handle, lowercase letters/digits/underscore, 3-20 chars

displayName.description: Display name, overriding the name from Google login. Unlike handle, any casing/spacing/accents are fine.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Birthday reminders about this account are timed against it.

birthdayReminderLeadDays.description: Days before a connection's birthday to be emailed, where 0 is the day itself. An empty array turns birthday emails off; omitting the field leaves the current preference untouched.

birthdayRemindersEnabled.description: Turns birthday reminder emails on or off without discarding the lead-time settings.

birthdayReminderDaysBefore.description: Days before a birthday for the daily reminder, where 0 is the day itself. Omitting the field leaves it untouched.

birthdayReminderWeeksBefore.description: Weeks before a birthday for the weekly reminder; 0 turns the weekly reminder off. Omitting the field leaves it untouched.

hasMore.description: Whether another page can be requested

isAdmin.description: Grant or revoke the admin role

isArtist.description: Grant or revoke the artist role

due.description: Birthdays landing on a reminder day right now

queued.description: Rows added to the outbox by this pass

alreadyQueued.description: Rows this pass derived that were already queued by an earlier pass

notified.description: In-app birthday notifications created by this pass

claimed.description: Rows claimed for sending by this pass

released.description: Claimed rows released back to the queue, either because the daily quota ran out mid-batch or because their template is unconfigured

rateLimited.description: Whether the provider reported a rate limit during this pass

remainingBudget.description: Sends still allowed today after this pass

deleted.description: Sent rows past the retention window, deleted

due.description: Number of jobs picked up this run

succeeded.description: Number of jobs that succeeded this run

uploadedById.description: Id of the account that uploaded this asset

hasMore.description: Whether another page can be requested

key.description: Object key returned by POST /images/sign. Exactly one of key/externalUrl is required.

externalUrl.description: Externally hosted image URL, as an alternative to uploading via key. Exactly one of key/externalUrl is required.

artistId.description: Id of the artist being commissioned

commissionOpeningId.description: Id of the CommissionOpening this is submitted through, if any

idea.description: Tiptap/ProseMirror JSON document describing the idea

isPublic.description: Whether this commission (status, type) should show in the public /queue

isHiddenInQueue.description: Whether this commission is hidden from the public /queue

originalQuote.description: Quote snapshotted at accept time, to detect later changes

slotCapEndsAt.description: Closes automatically at this time regardless of slot count

scheduledAt.description: When to open — omit to open immediately, set in the future to schedule

tagName.description: Name of the linked Tag, used for gallery filtering

enabled.description: Whether the artist has this type turned on
